lines.en: One turn of the gears, one step of mine
My iron feet land with a solid sound
Arcs jump between my joints

lines.zh: 我沿着电线杆的方向走
lines.en: I walk in the direction of the power lines
This body is heavy and steady
I stop and start, as if measuring

lines.zh: 导线在我背后拖出火花
lines.en: A wire trails sparks behind me
I take no detours, a straight line saves power
A belt loosened, so I tightened it

lines.zh: 我扫了一眼四周的电压
lines.en: I scan the voltage around me
The smell of rust follows me
I do not walk fast, but I never veer
I idle, and my fan hums
Current moves slowly through me

lines.zh: 我坐下就是一台发电机
lines.en: Sitting down, I become a generator
My indicator blinks and blinks
Once hooked to the grid, I work
I am quiet, only a hum
A wrench hangs at my side
Without orders, I do not stir
I am waiting for power

lines.zh: 坐着的我，比站着更省电
lines.en: Sitting saves more power than standing

lines.zh: 你的心跳有频率，我听得见
lines.en: Your heartbeat has a frequency I can hear

lines.zh: 我在判断你是不是主人
lines.en: I am deciding whether you are my master
The current in you is faint

lines.zh: 我没有表情，但我在看你
lines.en: I have no face, but I am looking at you
The wrench is on my hip, do not touch it
Will you repair me, or use me
I scanned you, no hostility found

lines.zh: 你手上的老茧我看得清
lines.en: I can see the calluses on your hands
I know your frequency
Please do not stand by the switch
A dent in my casing
My circuit shorted once
Sparks rise from my shoulder
I back off and reconnect
A joint grinds
This damage is repairable
I scan my own status
My fan is struggling
Half a panel came off
Still operational, do not worry

lines.zh: 那件东西，能修我的线路
lines.en: That item could patch my wiring
Give it and I break down less

lines.zh: 你手上那块铁，我很需要
lines.en: I need that iron in your hand
My list is not long

lines.zh: 递过来，我检查一下合不合
lines.en: Hand it over, I will check the fit
This is not food, it is supply

lines.zh: 东西对上了，我就跟你走
lines.en: If it fits, I come with you
One more piece, do not pull back
I can smell the grade of metal
Only repaired am I whole
You walked into solid iron

lines.zh: 我退了一点，关节响了一下
lines.en: I shift back and a joint creaks
There is current in me, be careful
Did that numb your hand
I have mass, you cannot move me
Iron on bone sounds unpleasant
One of my plates dented
Stand that close and you will feel a charge
Move aside, I need to connect
Do not touch my wires

lines.zh: 我不是自然长出来的东西
lines.en: I was not grown naturally
My kind are few, most of them broken
Linked together, our output rises
Two generators side by side work well

lines.zh: 我需要一个能修的伙伴
lines.en: I need a partner who can repair
Only machines on the same frequency get along
Let us sit side by side and switch on

lines.zh: 齿轮咬合的声音很好听
lines.en: Interlocking gears make a pleasant sound
I know maintenance, not tenderness

lines.zh: 同伴也是一种备用电源
lines.en: A partner is also a backup power source
I extend a clamp and grip it
I hold metal things steadily
This piece could serve as a part
I scan its composition
I hang it on my coil
A bit heavy, but my joints hold
Not iron, of little use
I tuck it into the hatch on my chest
You dropped it, I picked it up
Enough material for one repair
Hostile target, entering range
I lock its electromagnetic signal
This line should be cut
I do not like its frequency
Current is ready
It neared my master, remove it
My coil is heating up
Target at three o'clock
This strike is mine
I raise my discharge rod
Threat detected, entering combat
Wrench away, electrode out
I have the distance calculated
Discharge first, close in after
It stepped onto my circuit
I hold this radius
One step closer and it gets shocked
My field is expanding

lines.zh: 它每次靠近，我都算得准
lines.en: Each time it closes, I read it exactly
The wire is already at its feet

lines.zh: 它站在接地的位置，很糟
lines.en: It is standing on grounded ground, bad
I wait for it to take that step
Current creeps along the ground
When it retreats, I draw the field in
This stretch belongs to my grid
My fan is spinning faster
I can hear its heartbeat
Two more seconds
The wrench is useless for this

lines.zh: 它已经站在我的线路上了
lines.en: It is standing on my circuit now
Timing the discharge is critical
The voltage here is sufficient
My radius has not changed
The electric ray leaps out
One touch of my hand numbs it
My iron fist lands with sparks
Current runs through its whole body
Touch means shock, that is the principle
I shove, and it convulses
That strike was not clean
My coil is hot
One more contact is enough
Its legs shake, it cannot stand
I tap it with my wrench
The lightning scatters by my hand
Discharge over, I step back
It moves very slowly now
After this blow it goes slow
I raise my hand and it backs off

lines.zh: 我被拼起来了，一块一块
lines.en: I was pieced together, piece by piece

lines.zh: 损坏的我在工厂角落躺着
lines.en: Broken, I lay in a factory corner
Someone replaced my wiring
Current runs through me for the first time

lines.zh: 我站起来时掉了颗螺丝
lines.en: A screw fell as I stood up

lines.zh: 我不是野生的，是被修好的
lines.en: I am not wild, I was repaired
My indicator lights up for the first time
The wrench is here too, as it should be
I sweep this room once
Factory setting, idle first
I have not found a good grounding spot
Power on, I can move
The heat softens my wiring

lines.zh: 落地时我的一条腿错了位
lines.en: One leg misaligns in the landing
Water got in and I beep all over

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀翻，零件散了一地
lines.en: The blast flips me and parts scatter

lines.zh: 飞来的东西打穿了一块板
lines.en: Something flying punched through a panel

lines.zh: 这股能量和我的电不同
lines.en: This energy is not like my current

lines.zh: 没有补给，我的输出在降
lines.en: Without supply my output drops

lines.zh: 雷击过载了，我全身过电
lines.en: The lightning overloads me completely

lines.zh: 虚空里没有地线，我飘着
lines.en: No ground wire in the void, I drift
